title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1998 (1420). The lowest 59 inmates per correctional staff was reported from Orissa which indicate that the inmates were well attended for their reformation. Medical Staff is also very important constituent of the total strength. On the basis of medical staff strength, we may assess the health condition of inmates in prisons. Gujarat reported highest number of 407 inmates per medical staff followed by Kerala and Maharashtra (385 each) during the year 1998. Jammu & Kashmir (16) reported least number of inmates per medical staff.
